msg: There are two baskets to choose from, red and yellow. The red basket is linked to red, purple, pink and brown gnomes. However, the yellow basket is linked to the yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes. One of the baskets, red or yellow, will give more mushrooms at the start. Try to find which of the two it is. Then, the basket that is giving more mushrooms, choose this until the mushrooms you get, gets low down to 0, 1 or 2 mushrooms every time you choose this. THEN, SWITCH to the other basket which will give you more and more mushrooms. REPEAT the same process as the best basket of the two CHANGES. Remember, red basket is for red, purple, pink and brown gnomes, but the yellow basket is for yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes. Guess at the start to find the best basket giving the MOST mushrooms and follow these steps.
